INSERT INTO attendances (residentId, packageId, checkInTime, checkOutTime, durationMinutes, createdAt, updatedAt)
SELECT 
  r.id,
  p.id,
  DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 MINUTE),
  NOW(),
  5,
  NOW(),
  NOW()
FROM residents r
JOIN packages p ON p.residentId = r.id AND p.isActive = true
WHERE r.firstName = 'enka' AND r.lastName = 'enka'
LIMIT 1;
